verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents a dedicated `SandboxNetworkPolicy` that controls outbound traffic for a sandbox, and templates can set a default network policy, so egress is governed by explicit policy. Proxy-based egress and HTTP request controls add further outbound control. Missing for 10: documented detail on allow/deny rule semantics (domains, IPs, ports), examples of restrict versus allow configurations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
